Which closure should I choose?

Every size is available as Lace-Up or Velcro. Lace-Up gives the flattest, most secure wrist wrap, but someone has to tie them for you, so it suits sparring days and coached sessions. Velcro lets you glove up alone in seconds, which makes it the practical pick for solo bag rounds and busy training schedules. Not sure? Pick Velcro for everyday work and add a Lace-Up pair later.

What weight do I need?

10oz and 12oz cover most pad and bag work, 14oz is a comfortable all-rounder, and 16oz is the usual sparring weight. The range runs from 6oz to 18oz, so you can match it to your hand size and training plan.

How does it compare to other blues?

If you want something louder, look at the Metallic Blue & Gold. For a darker, quieter look, the Black pair hides wear better. Browse everything in the Cleto Reyes boxing gloves collection, or add a headguard with a complete sparring set.

Cleto Reyes Royal Blue Boxing Gloves FAQ

Does royal blue match a red Cleto Reyes pair for partners?

Yes. Royal blue and the Cleto Reyes Red gloves make a natural red and blue corner pair for training partners.

What headguard color goes with royal blue gloves?

Royal blue, black or white headguards all match. The Royal Blue sparring set includes a matching headguard and groinguard.

Is royal blue a good first glove color?

Yes. It is bright enough to feel special but hides marks better than white or yellow.

products.descriptionHtml:
Picture the walk to the ring: the lights drop, the crowd turns, and the first thing anyone sees is your hands. Full metallic gold leather exists for that moment. These Cleto Reyes Gold Metallic boxing gloves throw light back at cameras and corner staff, and they are built as a proper training glove underneath the shine, so they earn their place in the gym as well as in photos.

Lace-Up or Velcro on a gold glove?

Lace-Up keeps a clean line against the metallic surface and gives the firmest wrist hold, which is why many boxers choose it for fight cards and filmed sparring. Velcro trades a little of that lockdown for speed, so you can strap in alone between rounds.

Keeping the shine

Metallic finishes dislike water. Wipe the gloves with a soft dry cloth after each session, air-dry them with the cuff open, and avoid sprays or damp wipes. Treated this way, the gold stays bright far longer than it would with regular cleaning.

Want a cooler tone? Compare the Silver Metallic. Prefer gold only as an accent? See the Black & Gold Metallic. All styles live in the Cleto Reyes gloves collection.

What kit matches all-gold gloves?

How is this different from the elastic band gold pair?
